boundary: The field scan is new game-disjoint windows but belongs to the same previously used public100 historical database. Select games and turns using metadata only, then freeze all Tminus1 records and qualifying gate candidates BEFORE reading T. Field source coverage and game flags at Tminus1 do not prove activation during Host. Missing fields or missing flags mean unknown, not absent. Comparisons are posthost observations, not a true phase trace. Results of individual ships in the same episode are correlated. No future VCR, canon Host activation or combat promotion.
